text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Incident 1809992222 - embeddings API high 5xx rate in eu-west-1. Auto-paging oncall. Link: https://redwood-infra/ops/1809992222-metrics

maria (Support Lead): paging received. prepping customer comms + status page draft. can someone paste a short public blurb we can use for statuspage?

diego (oncall): looking. seeing elevated 5xx from transformer-host-27 around 04:02 UTC, error spike correlates with model-quantize rollout. will roll back if needed.

ying (SRE): can you run this quick query in logs to surface top error codes?
ying (SRE): ````
index=prod-logs service=embeddings | stats count by status_code | sort -count
````

maria (Support Lead): thanks @ying. i'll draft the initial public status message and a zendesk macro for CS to copy. starting with a short, neutral public update.

support-bot: uploaded macro file: /macros/embeddings-eu5xx-macro.v1 (visible to support). :white_check_mark:

maria (Support Lead): PUBLIC STATUSPAGE DRAFT (short):
````
We are experiencing elevated error rates for the Embeddings API in eu-west-1. Our engineers are investigating and working to restore normal service. No action required from customers at this time. We will provide updates every 15 minutes.
````

maria (Support Lead): INTERNAL STATUSPAGE DRAFT (more detail):
````
Impact: Increased 5xx errors for /v1/embeddings in eu-west-1 affecting a subset of requests.
Detection: Automated alerts + customer reports at 04:02 UTC.
Mitigation: Rolling back latest quantized model deployment. Autoscaling increased capacity while rollback completes.
Next update: 15 minutes or on material change.
````

cassie (CS): please also add a short customer-facing zendesk macro that agents can paste into tickets. keep it non-technical and include a link to status page.

maria (Support Lead): ZENDESK / INTERCOM MACRO (copyable):
````
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

Thanks for reporting this. Our engineering team is aware of an issue affecting the Embeddings API in eu-west-1 and is actively working on a fix. We expect no action is needed from you — we'll update this ticket and our status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1809992222

If you are seeing immediate business impact, please reply with example request IDs and timestamps and we'll prioritize.

Apologies for the disruption,
Redwood Support
````

cassie (CS): nice, short and safe. can we add a one-click escalation snippet for high-severity customers?

maria (Support Lead): ESCALATION SNIPPET (for CS to paste into ticket):
````
Escalation: Customer reports production impact. Requesting oncall attention: @oncall. Customer: {{account.name}}. Severity: high. Examples attached: request_ids.
````

diego (oncall): rollback started at 04:08 UTC. taking nodes out of LB. will post progress.

ying (SRE): monitoring metrics, tailing logs. if rollback doesn't decrease 5xx in 2 mins we consider revert + scale up.

maria (Support Lead): AGENT TRIAGE CHECKLIST (short):
- Confirm customer region (eu-west-1) and collect request_id + timestamp.
- Provide macro above and link to status page.
- If customer impact = business-critical, use escalation snippet.
- Tag ticket with incident: 1809992222 and assignee: oncall.

maria (Support Lead): AGENT TROUBLESHOOTING STEPS (cmds to run locally / ask customer):
````
- Confirm API endpoint and body size. Invalid payloads rarely cause 5xx but helpful to check.
- Ask for example request_id and paste here so oncall can match logs.
- If possible, ask customer to retry after 2-3 minutes and report result.
````

cassie (CS): added macro to zendesk with visibility flag. starting to send to affected customers who opened tickets.

diego (oncall): rollback in progress -> 50% rolled back (04:10 UTC). 5xx rate down ~40% in initial aggregation.

ying (SRE): good sign, continue monitoring. set alert to notify if 5xx > 2% for next 10m.

maria (Support Lead): INTERNAL NOTE for agents: do not promise ETA. reference status page and offer to escalate. keep replies empathetic.

cassie (CS): sending templated replies now to 12 open tickets (low-touch). will escalate 3 customers per escalation snippet.

diego (oncall): rollback complete (04:12 UTC). current 5xx back to baseline in eu-west-1. keeping service in observation for 30m before closing incident.

ying (SRE): marking mitigated in internal tracker. will capture logs and create a short timeline for postmortem.

maria (Support Lead): FINAL CUSTOMER-FACING UPDATE (when mitigated):
````
Update: The issue affecting the Embeddings API in eu-west-1 has been mitigated. Normal request success rates have resumed. We will follow up with a post-incident update once we complete our internal review. Thank you for your patience.
````

diego (oncall): acknowledged. handoff to follow - leaving notes in the incident doc including rollback timestamp and A/B test id.

maria (Support Lead): HANDOFF CHECKLIST for next oncall:
- Incident ID: 1809992222
- Mitigation action: rollback quantized model deployment at 04:08 UTC -> complete 04:12 UTC
- Remaining work: postmortem + customer follow-up (maria to draft)
- Observability links: https://redwood-infra/ops/1809992222-logs, https://redwood-infra/ops/1809992222-metrics

ying (SRE): will add the alert query and graph snapshots to incident doc.

support-bot: incident status updated to MITIGATED by diego at 04:12 UTC. :tada:

maria (Support Lead): thanks everyone. i'll draft the postmortem and the formal customer follow-ups. closing thread here for comm templates — archived under /support/macros/incident-embeddings-1809992222.json

cassie (CS): good job team. tagging customers once postmortem is ready.

incident-bot: thread closed (archived).
_meta: Generated Slack thread for incident communications templates and agent macros
